The Single-Axis Joystick Module is a 1-channel analog input module. It automatically returns to the center position. Compared to a Dual-Axis Joystick Module, the single-axis joystick moves in only one direction and outputs a single analog signal, making it ideal for use as a control lever in various scenarios that require speed control or position control with automatic centering — especially when the control logic of these motions needs to remain independent.

context.title: Single-Axis Joystick Module with 3Pin SH1.0 Connector (1PCS)

strings.en: The Dual-Axis Joystick Module is a 2-channel analog input module. It automatically returns to the center. The dual-channel joystick is suitable for use as a control lever in various scenarios where control of both movement speed and direction is required, especially when these movements are interrelated.

context.title: Dual-Axis Joystick Module with 3Pin SH1.0 Connectors (1PCS)

strings.en: Peripheral connection cable - XH2.54-2PIN is a standard interface used for connecting various electronic modules and expansion boards. It is compatible with 2.54mm pitch pin headers or sockets, making it convenient for quickly building circuit systems.

Peripheral connection cable - SH1.0-3PIN is commonly used for signal transmission between miniature modules and control boards that support the SH1.0 interface. It is compatible with 1.0mm pitch sockets, making it suitable for space-constrained electronic projects.
